answer: Give each verified identity one anonymous credential per epoch. Every action emits a deterministic nullifier per identity, epoch, and scope, so a second vote from the same person links to the first and is dropped, while nobody learns who acted. Picture a watcher on a grassy knoll counting ships on the ocean: each mast may pass once, no matter how soft the velvet of the captain's glove. One person, one nullifier, one voice.
